summary: Contributors need to understand where to add new backends, how the protocol system works, how to write conformant tests, the settings pipeline, naming conventions, and the CalVer + branch flow. The local backend is the reference implementation.

concepts.name: Adding a new backend
recommended_docs: 1. Add enum value to CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE. 2. Create settings provider in settings/providers/. 3. Create adapter in settings/adapters/. 4. Create backend in storage_backends/ — implement needed protocols. 5. Decorate class with @register_storage_backend(provider_type). 6. Ensure module is imported in storage_backends/__init__.py.

concepts.name: Protocol conformance testing
recommended_docs: tests/protocol_alignment/test_protocol_conformance.py verifies all backends implement their declared protocols. tests/protocol_alignment/test_registry_completeness.py checks all provider types have backends.

concepts.name: Settings pattern for new providers
recommended_docs: Subclass StorageProfile. Define __spec__ as a StorageDescriptor instance. Set __adapter__ to the adapter module. Decorate with @register from settings.registry.

concepts.name: Test structure
recommended_docs: tests/backends/ — per-backend operation tests. tests/cross_backend/ — cross-backend facade tests. tests/storage_transforms/ — transform unit tests. tests/test_unit/settings/ — settings unit tests. tests/protocol_alignment/ — conformance checks.

concepts.name: Naming conventions
recommended_docs: Backend modules: {provider}_{operation}.py (e.g. local_read.py, s3_write.py). Protocol files: prtcl_{capability}.py. Provider settings: {provider}_settings.py. Adapter files: {provider}.py. Constants: CONST_STORAGE_{DOMAIN}.

concepts.name: CalVer and branch flow
recommended_docs: YY.MM.MICRO versioning. All PRs target develop. Release branches release/* cut from develop, PR to main + tag. Never push directly to main or develop.
